page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no marginal notes. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Catchword at lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: morosè damnanda esse omnia philosophorum placita.
Ratio: quia multa ingeniosè & utiliter tradat: in multis vel ingenii abusu vel ignorantia aberrent à vero.

Accommodetur ad hypothesin præsentem: Platonem quoque de repub. multa præclarè scribere: Recensentur nonnulla: Quod τὸ ὅσιον[?] hoc est, religio sit basis Politiæ: Quod τ' ὁμιλητικὸν[?] sit nervus societatis humanæ: Quod in repub. omnia ad communem utilitatem referre oporteat: Quod felix sit respub. quæ à Philosophis, h. e, piis & sapientibus gubernatur, &c.
Adversat. Sed portentosam insaniam esse, quam requirit in civitate, omnium rerum [illegible, ~11 letters]

Transitio ad propositionem: Cum amicus seu exercendi ingenii seu discendi causa ejus defensionem ad te miserit, te breviter responsurum: 1. de uxorum & liberorum 2 de facultatum [illegible, ~10 letters]
Prima pars propositionis: Communionem uxorum & liberorum procul à civitate arcendam esse.

Ratio 1. quia sit impia repugnans ordinationi & verbo Dei. Homo adhærebit uxori suæ: Erunt duo in carne una: quisque vir suam habeat uxorem: viri diligite uxores vestras: Honora patrem tuum & matrem tuam: Liberi obedite parentibus vestris, &c.
Amplificetur à judicato, quod sit jam olim damnata hæresis Simonitarum, Nicolaitarum &

page.notes: The Greek words after "Quod" in the Accommodetur paragraph are only partly legible; the marked readings are doubtful. The two Greek words ending the Adversat. and Transitio lines (broken at the line end with a hyphen) could not be read letter by letter. The Greek word after "Quod" in the first line of the Accommodetur paragraph may be τὸ ὅσιον or a close form. The page number and running head are printed in small capitals and are transcribed as capitals. No signature is visible. The faint text showing through from the facing page has been omitted.
